verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's own site presents CHKit as giving agents "typed commands to describe, validate, test, and deploy schema and pipelines as code" that can run in CI, which reads as an official, agent-drivable command-line tool. Its documented scope is limited to schema and pipeline-as-code, and it is never explicitly called a CLI. Compatibility with stock ClickHouse clients is a host-ecosystem capability and earns no credit. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that CHKit is an official CLI with install and reference docs, CLI coverage of cluster/service management (create, scale, branch, monitor), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
